# [pixi](../../index.md) [workspace](../index.md) [preview](index.md) add

Add preview flag(s) to the workspace

--8<-- "docs/reference/cli/pixi/workspace/preview/add_extender:description"

## Usage
```
pixi workspace preview add <PREVIEW_FLAG>...
```

## Arguments
- <a id="arg-PREVIEW_FLAG" href="#arg-PREVIEW_FLAG">`<PREVIEW_FLAG>`</a>
:  The preview flag(s) to add or remove, e.g. `pixi-build`
<br>May be provided more than once.
<br>**required**: `true`
<br>**options**: `pixi-build`

## Description
Add preview flag(s) to the workspace.

Example: `pixi workspace preview add pixi-build`
